text.title: W3C Design Tokens Standard Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on how many consumers read the token source, whether a transform step exists that understands DTCG, and whether the set contains composites or cross-group aliases — to full application, a scalar-only minimum, or skip in favour of plain custom properties.

decision-tree.root-question: How many consumers read the token source, and is there a build step between the source and them that understands DTCG?

branch.when: one consumer (web CSS only), no design-tool round-trip, and the values are hand-copied into stylesheets with no build step

conclusion.verdict: skip; a single file of CSS custom properties is cheaper and loses nothing — a JSON layer in front of the only file anyone edits drifts on the first hotfix

branch.when: a build step exists but the transform tool in use has no DTCG support and reads only its own native schema

conclusion.verdict: skip; document the tool's native schema instead — authoring a format nothing in the pipeline parses produces a file that is never read and never fails

branch.when: two or more consumers (web plus iOS/Android, or a design-tool round-trip) sit behind a transform that reads DTCG
branch.question: What does the token set contain: flat scalars only, composite types and cross-group aliases, or values that must survive a design-tool round-trip with vendor metadata attached?

branch.when: flat scalar palette only — colours and dimensions, no aliases, no composites

conclusion.verdict: apply the minimum path: `$value` plus a `$type` resolvable on the token or an ancestor group, legal names, `.tokens.json` identity, and a pinned draft revision

branch.when: the set carries composite types (typography, border, shadow, transition, gradient) and/or aliases across groups

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; alias targets must terminate at tokens with a matching type, composites must be structured objects rather than CSS shorthand, and the targeted draft revision must be pinned alongside the toolchain version

branch.when: tokens round-trip through a design tool (Figma Variables export/import) and carry tool-specific metadata

conclusion.verdict: apply with the interchange rules first: `.tokens`/`.tokens.json` identity and every vendor key under `$extensions` in reverse-domain form, so the round-trip does not silently drop or collide with spec keys
